Bollywood Actor Rejects Career Advice from Salman Khan

Actor Randeep Hooda has rejected career advice from Salman Khan, stating that doing the same type of roles is 'boring'. The actor's decision comes after Khan suggested he take on similar parts to his own films. Hooda's rejection highlights the challenges faced by actors in maintaining their careers and staying relevant in the industry.
